Rhīnŏcŏlūra ,
		ae, f., 
I.a town on the borders of Syria and Egypt on the
				shore of the Mediterranean, prob. the mod. El-Arish, Plin. 5, 13, 14, § 68;
				Liv.
				45, 11; Sen. Ira, 3, 20, 2;
					Amm. 22, 16, 3.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
